**S25 scores:** Emotion/story 2 · Sound-off 3 · Pacing 2 · Composition 2

1. **At 8.7 s:** The beam floats in mid-air, well right of the house, and Tessa stands with her back to it. Nothing ties the 7.40% bar to her loan. Fix: grow the beam up out of the house wall, and turn Tessa to look up at it as it rises.
2. **At 14.5 s:** This frame matches 8.7 s except for one new label, so the picture is static for about 6 seconds. Also, a red blur artifact sits at the top centre. Fix: on "no longer pays" (15.6 s), show a small interest coin dropping off the dollar and fading out, so "interest she no longer pays" happens on screen. Remove the red artifact.
3. **At 20.3 s:** The "any other use" dollar is a dim dashed ghost sitting low on the far right, below the beam. That reads as "it fails the bar," and it isn't held up against the beam as the brief asks. Fix: on "any other use" (18.2 s), a hand raises a solid dollar right up to the beam's end, level with it.
4. **At 26.1 s:** The ghost dollar now sits above the bar. That shows it clearing the bar, which contradicts "isn't tested." Its label also runs into "7.40%." Fix: keep the dollar right at beam level and add a "?" bracket (or uncertainty haze) spanning above and below the beam. Move its label clear of the axis text.

**S26 scores:** Emotion/story 2 · Sound-off 2 · Pacing 3 · Composition 2

1. **At 0.88–6.14 s:** The beam with the dollar stays parked on the left at a fixed height, and only a grey stub sits at the chart's end. "The bar moves" is never shown. Fix: put the dollar-beam itself on the line and slide it along the line, so it rises and falls with the rate.
2. **At 2.63 s:** The chart has no year ticks and no y-axis, so "since 1991" and the beam's height can't be read with sound off. Fix: add a baseline with 1991 and 2026 ticks and a faint 7.40% reference line that continues from S25.
3. **At 4.38 s:** The peak label appears about 1.4 s before "nine point two five" (5.8 s), and before its marker exists. Fix: on "high" (5.1 s), move the beam up to the 1994 peak and light up the marker, then bring in the number on 5.8 s.
4. **At 6.14–7.89 s:** These two frames are identical, which is dead time. Tessa and the house are also tiny in the corner and play no part. Fix: on "percent" (7.0 s), have the beam with the dollar settle back to today's 7.40% so the scene reads as a round trip. Remove the leftover left-hand beam.
